note: Freely distributable homebrew. Entries may be console ROMs, wasmcart (.wasc) cartridges, or sandboxed JS games — romdeck plays all three from one library.

entries.title: Starfall
entries.author: built with romdev
entries.description: Catch the golden stars, dodge the meteors. Hardware sprites, twinkling starfield, SID sound. Joystick port 2.

entries.title: Snake
entries.author: wasmcart examples
entries.description: The classic, as a native WASM cartridge — any language, compiled once, runs at native speed.

entries.title: JS Game Starter
entries.author: monteslu
entries.description: A sandboxed JavaScript game running in the same library as your ROMs — canvas, WebAudio and gamepad, no browser.

entries.title: Celeste Classic
entries.author: Maddy Thorson & Noel Berry
entries.description: The original PICO-8 Celeste — the prototype that became the full game.

entries.title: Stallar
entries.author: Wendel Scardua
entries.description: Steer a falling star through a collapsing sky. Made for Ludum Dare 50.

entries.title: File Fixers
entries.author: Wendel Scardua
entries.description: A computer-themed RPG: repair corrupted files by fighting what got into them.

entries.title: 8-Bit Table Tennis
entries.author: Michael Billington
entries.description: Two-player table tennis. Grab a second controller.

entries.title: Speedrun Tower
entries.author: Hugues Johnson
entries.description: Climb the tower against the clock. The compiled game is CC BY-SA 4.0.

entries.title: Google Dino Advance
entries.author: fritzem
entries.description: The Chrome offline dinosaur, on a Game Boy Advance. Sprites are BSD-3-Clause from Chromium.
